releaseNotes: V893 closes the reproduced VPN + rapid-Refresh PDO continuity gap: the diagnostic shows P8 last committed ACTIVE 010001 with no later Studio OFF write, while MAX/parallel PD subsequently resumed. Recovery is therefore driven by transport-delivery edges without resetting the PLC desired state.
LIVE Refresh now arms continuity as soon as the first single-flight request starts, keeps rapid extra clicks coalesced, and stays in the runtime-safe path while Auto Live still owns ACTIVE PDO ports.

Continuity recovery is generic for every currently ACTIVE Studio sequence PDO port. Refresh request/completion, TCP reconnect, V891 transport-hold recovery, same-device identity refresh, and MAX/parallel-PD resume all reassert through the existing Runtime path and PdoOutputCoordinator after the existing safety guards pass.
No protected low-level transport/ISDU/PDI/PDO coordinator area or Signal Tower arbitration semantics were redesigned.

en: Fixed the VPN + rapid Refresh PDO continuity gap by arming recovery at Refresh request start and on MAX/parallel-PD source resume.
Continuity recovery now covers every currently ACTIVE Studio sequence PDO port while keeping rapid Refresh clicks single-flight/coalesced.
All recovery writes remain serialized through the existing Runtime path and PdoOutputCoordinator with same-device and safety guards.
ko: VPN 연결 상태에서 Refresh 연타 시 발생한 PDO continuity gap을 Refresh 요청 시작 edge와 MAX/parallel-PD source resume edge로 보완했습니다.
continuity recovery를 현재 ACTIVE인 모든 Studio 시퀀스 PDO 포트로 범용화했으며 Refresh 연타는 single-flight/coalesce를 유지합니다.
모든 복구 write는 기존 Runtime 경로와 PdoOutputCoordinator를 사용하며 same-device/safety guard를 그대로 유지합니다.
ja: VPN 接続中の連続 Refresh で発生する PDO continuity gap を、Refresh request 開始 edge と MAX/parallel-PD source resume edge で補強しました。
continuity recovery は現在 ACTIVE のすべての Studio sequence PDO port を対象とし、連続 Refresh は single-flight/coalesce を維持します。
すべての recovery write は既存 Runtime 経路と PdoOutputCoordinator を使用し、same-device/safety guard を維持します。
zh-CN: 通过 Refresh 请求开始边沿和 MAX/parallel-PD source 恢复边沿，修复了 VPN 状态下连续点击 Refresh 的 PDO continuity 缺口。
continuity recovery 现覆盖当前所有 ACTIVE 的 Studio sequence PDO 端口，同时保持 Refresh single-flight/coalesce。
所有 recovery write 仍通过现有 Runtime 路径和 PdoOutputCoordinator，并保留 same-device/safety guard。
de: Die PDO-Continuity-Lücke bei VPN + schnellem Refresh wurde durch einen Recovery-Trigger beim Start des Refresh-Requests und beim MAX/Parallel-PD-Resume geschlossen.
Die Continuity-Recovery gilt jetzt für alle aktuell ACTIVE Studio-Sequence-PDO-Ports; schnelle Refresh-Klicks bleiben Single-Flight/Coalesced.
Alle Recovery-Writes laufen weiterhin serialisiert über den bestehenden Runtime-Pfad und PdoOutputCoordinator mit unveränderten Same-Device/Safety-Guards.
es: Se cerró la brecha de continuidad PDO con VPN + Refresh rápido armando la recuperación al iniciar el Refresh y al reanudarse MAX/parallel-PD.
La recuperación de continuidad ahora cubre todos los puertos PDO ACTIVE de las secuencias de Studio y mantiene Refresh en single-flight/coalesce.
Todas las escrituras de recuperación siguen serializadas por la ruta Runtime existente y PdoOutputCoordinator con los mismos guards de identidad y seguridad.
